queries.sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.ticket_number, t.ticket_subject, t.dept_id, t.assigned_staff_id, t.accountable_staff_id, t.created_by_staff_id, t.user_id, t.status_id FROM {prefix}ticket t WHERE t.status_id != 3 ORDER BY t.ticket_id

SELECT t.ticket_id, t.ticket_number, t.ticket_subject, t.dept_id, t.assigned_staff_id, t.accountable_staff_id, t.created_by_staff_id, t.user_id, t.status_id FROM {prefix}ticket t WHERE t.status_id = 3 ORDER BY t.ticket_id

SELECT sr.report_id, sr.ticket_id, sr.appointment_id, sr.report_number, sr.report_name, sr.report_status, sr.report_type, sr.report_date, sr.created_by, sr.closed_by, sr.closed_at FROM {prefix}service_report_header sr WHERE sr.report_status != 'closed' ORDER BY sr.report_id

SELECT sr.report_id, sr.ticket_id, sr.appointment_id, sr.report_number, sr.report_name, sr.report_status, sr.report_type, sr.report_date, sr.created_by, sr.closed_by, sr.closed_at FROM {prefix}service_report_header sr WHERE sr.report_status = 'closed' ORDER BY sr.report_id

SELECT s.staff_id, s.name, sa.email, sda.dept_id, r.name AS role_name, r.permissions FROM {prefix}staff s JOIN {prefix}staff_account sa ON sa.staff_id = s.staff_id JOIN {prefix}staff_dept_access sda ON sda.staff_id = s.staff_id JOIN {prefix}roles r ON r.id = sda.role_id
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.start_datetime, a.end_datetime, a.status, a.ticket_id, a.customer_id, a.user_id, a.department_id FROM {prefix}appointment a WHERE a.status != 3 ORDER BY a.id
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.start_datetime, a.end_datetime, a.status, a.ticket_id, a.customer_id, a.user_id, a.department_id FROM {prefix}appointment a WHERE a.status = 3 ORDER BY a.id
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.status FROM {prefix}organization o WHERE o.status = 1 ORDER BY o.id
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.status FROM {prefix}organization o WHERE o.status = 0 ORDER BY o.id
